news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.28 (vs ₹0.78 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.28 (down from ₹0.78 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹37.9m (down 41% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹12.9m (down 65% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 34% (down from 57% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 4% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 55% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.7% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 46% Last year net profit margin: 70% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.40 (vs ₹0.53 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.40 (down from ₹0.53 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹41.6m (up 3.6% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹18.9m (down 24% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 45% (down from 62% in 2Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 9% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 43% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
